outputs.contract: bounded leaf or explicit refusal, not canonical completion

acceptance: objective demonstrably delivered by named receipts at exact SHA
all negative controls fail the planted defect and pass final implementation
canonical owning status updated under lease only after evidence; no duplicate delivery status in this research
tracked handoff names open gates and next task; branch pushed under repository policy

positive_and_negative_controls: Use canonical acceptance cases in embedded detail; skips are NOT_RUN.
Foreign Estate/Project/source, revoked grant, wrong checksum, source error and stale revision cannot become empty/success.
Crash/replay must preserve acknowledged source range and one effect; unknown coverage remains unknown.
required_delivery_checks: run module-specific meaningful tests; record exact command/exit/SHA
update scenarios/flows/model for user-facing work; code region refs; fast CI and map gates before commit
native/provider/browser acceptance separately named; skipped checks remain NOT_RUN

guards: missing authority, source policy, capability or schema contract: stop effect and report typed blocker
unknown outcome: reconcile stable command/effect id before retry
unrelated agent work/file claim: do not overwrite; send finding to lead
Stop before implementation until a bounded leaf and upstream acceptance/authority are approved; a planning dependency is not a completion receipt.
Reconcile a current bounded owner packet before dispatch; new source hashes do not renew historical acceptance
resume: Read this packet and its pinned canonical sources; verify trigger, dependency receipts and authority; produce one bounded follow-on leaf before code.
